_note: The open-work ledger. Each item names the accept criteria in docs/roadmap.md or docs/testing.md; no number here is a result.

items.title: Full context with the drafter and vision
items.accept: A full-context load with the drafter and vision, the depth-KLD table at the deep windows, and decode at those windows above the NInfer floors.

items.title: NInfer quality and a like-for-like speed run
items.accept: One table with every arm on the same base and the same fixtures; KLD only if NInfer exposes the gate; speed ABBA with the power limit recorded.

items.title: KLD at long context
items.accept: Scored windows placed at the deep contexts, per cache format, against the same frozen base. The dense path has its table (the depth finding); the sparse path's has not run.

items.title: Strata KLD
items.accept: The same gate on Strata with its own pack and reference, so the speed table gains a quality column.

items.title: Task-level eval
items.accept: A Lite run with a recorded resolve rate, no engine failures, and one scaffold for every arm.

items.title: Tool calls beyond one set
items.accept: A broader labelled set with whether-to-call accuracy against the reference path.

items.title: Dense sampling distribution
items.accept: Seeded runs per prompt, with the first choice and the first ten inside the reference build's own spread.

items.title: A release-gate report file
items.accept: One file per release with the commit, the profile and manifest hashes, KLD and speeds, so the ledger names a release instead of an eval directory.

items.title: Concurrency and cancellation
items.accept: Scripted concurrent clients and aborts mid-stream, with no stuck leases.

items.title: The container image
items.accept: Build, serve and one smoke inside the image.
